study: Executed-layer KV admission on capacity-constrained sub-pool placements
admission: FIFO source waiting; reserve prompt plus public output bound 1000 tokens for each actually executed layer; decode keeps prompt route; release only after actual KV removal. No future output length, dropping or preemption.
selection: Screen all three preregistered candidates at seed101 for 600 seconds. Require throughput >= Helix and P95 TTFT/TPOT <= Helix. Select fewest physical GPUs among passing candidates, then greatest throughput. If none passes, preserve negative evidence and revise placement in a new protocol.
